name: Sex Witch No-Gno
source:
In an attempt to shake off her hibernation, Clara takes to the supermarket where she meets a nice, anxious buck boy. But.. he seems to be hiding something... wild. She and her roommate Dorian be able to draw the secret out of the sheepish buck? And if they do, will they survive the night?
